record.issue_text: guests array has no max() in the Zod schema, allowing authorized callers to add thousands of attendees in one mutation

adjudication.rationale: The new TRPC input schema in `packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings/addGuests.schema.ts` defines `guests: z.array(z.string().email())` with no `.max(...)` (or other size limit). The handler `addGuestsHandler` then `createMany` attendees and triggers calendar updates plus `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)`, so an authorized caller could submit a very large `guests` array and cause excessive DB writes, external calendar operations, and email sends in a single mutation.
